info.name: CYCLES_VOLUME_PRINCIPLED
comment: Cycles vendor extension: 'principled' volume subtype driving Cycles'
with the density sampled from a spatial field -- richer than
transferFunction1D for smoke and fire. The field value times
'densityScale' is the extinction density sigma_t; 'color' is the
single-scattering albedo, 'absorptionColor' tints the extinction, and
-- either a constant or a second spatial field (fire). The 'id'
parameter feeds 'channel.objectId' like on transferFunction1D. All
shading defaults equal the Cycles Principled Volume socket defaults.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: spatial field providing the volume density

parameters.name: densityScale
parameters.description: scale applied to the field value to get the extinction density

parameters.name: absorptionColor
parameters.description: tint of the volume extinction (light passing through takes this color)

parameters.name: blackbodyIntensity
parameters.description: strength of the blackbody emission at 'temperature'

parameters.name: blackbodyTint
parameters.description: tint applied to the blackbody emission

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: blackbody temperature in Kelvin: a constant or a spatial field (fire)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: user id for objectId channel (KHR_FRAME_CHANNEL_OBJECT_ID; the registry's anonymous ANARI_VOLUME 'id' entry only merges into the first volume subtype)
